label: 214-cv-001b-marker-fix
rootCause: Post-import connector config used read-modify-write patches that clobbered cvMetricsRefreshJobId. handleXeroImportJobSettled wrote lastSuccessAt via updateConnectorOutcomeMeta before CV mark, and subsequent autoSync patches (outcome meta, two-way verify queue) could overwrite the marker when merging stale autoSync snapshots.

changes: Added mergeAutoSyncState + patchConnectorAutoSync to preserve cvMetricsRefreshJobId/cvMetricsRefreshAt and two-way verify markers across connector config updates.
Reordered handleXeroImportJobSettled: CV refresh + mark runs before integration outcome meta patch.
Wrapped CV refresh failures in try/catch so import settle completes; scheduler fallback retries refreshPendingCustomerValueMetrics.
Added unit tests for call order and marker preservation.
